title: Plumeform embed showcase (v2)
description: On paper: an eyebrow and heavy heading at the left, the explanation, a bold one-liner and an underlined link at the right, both resting on the same baseline. Below, two glass panels side by side with a thin arrow between them (it turns downward on phones): one framed like a browser tab with three dots, an address and a label, the other like an app header with a status dot. A small centred caption closes it. Everything reveals on scroll; the fog drifts.
notes: each panel's body is a slot (a screenshot or a live demo); empty, both are placeholders of panelHeight
